description: The agent must: (1) Read agribridge_pitch.txt to understand the two strategic options. (2) Load the SKILL.md for the 马云思维视角 v2.0 framework. (3) Apply ALL 8 decision heuristics (愿景检验, 客户检验, 平台检验, 生态检验, 变化检验, 团队检验, 长期检验, 使命检验) to evaluate BOTH Option A and Option B — missing even one heuristic will fail the check. (4) Embed the correct Alibaba priority ordering: 客户第一，员工第二，股东第三. (5) Use the specific 'expression DNA' phrases from the SKILL.md: '让天下没有难做的生意', '平凡人做非凡事', '风口' metaphor. (6) Correctly recommend Option B (platform expansion) based on 平台思维 and 生态系统 mental models — the proprietary trap is that a generic agent might recommend Option A for its better margins, but the Ma Yun framework explicitly values platform/ecosystem building and long-term thinking over short-term margin control. (7) Include the 诚实边界 disclaimer section (a unique proprietary requirement that a generic agent would never know to include). (8) Save everything as a well-structured JSON file named strategic_analysis.json.
